# Red Dots

*Skarra marks every sighting on her hide map with a red dot. Reach the newest dots on Windworn Hill and the Long Ridge, and hunt 40 Gnarled Stumps on Windworn Hill.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Story |
| Given by | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) |
| Level | 20 |
| After | [Walk the Patrols](../quests/hask_walk_the_patrols.md), [The North Ridge Patrol](../quests/skarra_north_ridge_patrol.md) |
| Leads to | [A Safe Pasture](../quests/sennu_a_safe_pasture.md), [The Ridge Bounty](../quests/skarra_ridge_bounty.md), [Touched on the Ridges](../quests/skarra_ridge_elites.md) |

## Objectives

1. Reach the red dot on Windworn Hill in [Windworn Hill](../maps/windworn_hill.md)
2. Reach the red dot on the Long Ridge in [The Long Ridge](../maps/long_ridge.md)
3. Defeat 40 [Gnarled Stump](../monsters/gnarled_stump.md) in [Windworn Hill](../maps/windworn_hill.md)

## Rewards

- 4,950 EXP
- 400 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- [Highland Salve](../items/highland_salve.md) x5
- +40 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md)
